title: Universal Immunoblot Analysis for Investigating Protein-AG Binding to Immunoglobulins
author: Angel A Justiz-Vaillant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bjseknbe
materials: Gels are transferred to nitrocellulose membranes (Immobilon-Nc, pore size 0.45 µm, Sigma-Aldrich Co, St Louis, Missouri) during 71 minutes at 40 mAmps using a semi-dry electroblotter, HEP-1 Model, Owl Scientific Inc.
The nitrocellulose membranes were washed as above.
A secondary antibody (rabbit anti-chicken IgY horseradish peroxidase, Sigma Aldrich) is added at a 1:15 000 dilution.

steps.title: Perform SDS-PAGE
steps.instruction: Apply aliquots of egg yolks, animal sera, or 2 µg/µl of purified immunoglobulins from birds, laboratory, wild, farm animals, and pets to SDS-PAGE gels.

substeps.instruction: Use a running buffer containing 25 mM Tris, 192 mM glycine pH 8.3, and 20% methanol.

steps.title: Block and Wash Membranes
steps.instruction: Block nitrocellulose membranes overnight and perform subsequent washes.

substeps.instruction: Block overnight in 10% non-fat skim milk in PBS with 0.05% Tween-20 pH 7.4.
Wash 4 times for 10 minutes each with PBS-Tween 20.

steps.title: Incubate with Protein-AG/G
steps.instruction: Apply Protein-AG or Protein-A/G mixture to the membranes and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add a mixture of SpA and SpG at a concentration of 5 µg/ml (or use recombinant Protein-AG/SpAG instead).

steps.title: Secondary Incubation and Washing
steps.instruction: Perform a second incubation and wash the membranes.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for one hour at room temperature.
Wash as described in the blocking step (PBS-Tween 20).

steps.title: Develop Blot with TMB
steps.instruction: Visualize protein binding using Tetramethyl-benzidine (TMB) solution.

substeps.instruction: Add TMB solution to the nitrocellulose membranes.
Incubate in the dark for seven minutes.
Shake membranes gently and rinse thoroughly in de-ionized water to stop the blotting process.

steps.title: Alternative Direct Probing Method
steps.instruction: Alternatively, use a direct probing system, primarily for detecting avian Igs.

substeps.instruction: Transfer Ig samples to nitrocellulose membranes.
